title.narrative: Turning universal rights into local reality: Strengthening sexual and reproductive health and rights and the protection of environmental human rights

description.narrative: Promote the translation and implementation of international human rights obligations, commitments, and recommendations, into improved national legislation, policies, and practices in developing countries, thereby assisting duty bearers and other stakeholders with the protection, promotion, and fulfilment of the rights of individuals at the domestic level, with a focus on on sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR) and environmental human rights defenders (EHRDs).
